format.description: The shape of the files in specs/ and .spex/, as one integer. Missing means 1. The script refuses a newer format and asks for `spex update` on an older one.

acceptance_dir.description: Where the default driver's test files live. Every driver dir is protected: no task writes a test.

acceptance_cmd.description: The default driver. Shell command; {ids} becomes the test names joined by |, {ids_k} the names joined by ' or ' (pytest -k).

drivers.description: More ways to run script tests, by name: `playwright: {cmd: 'npx playwright test --grep "{ids}"', dir: tests/e2e}`. A test names one with `driver:`; `shell` is built in and runs the steps as commands.

repo.description: A key of repos: the command runs in that repo, and dir is inside it.

repos.description: Other git repos a task may write, by name: `web: {path: ../web-ui}`. Specs and .spex/ stay in this repo. A task names one with `repo:`, a driver with `repo:`.

path.description: From this repo's root (../web-ui), or absolute (/… or ~/…). In git worktrees use an absolute one: a worktree's root is another folder.

base.description: The branch its review diff starts from. Absent: the commit it was at when its first task opened.

fast_checks.description: Run in that repo when a task writes it.

protected.description: No task writes these, inside that repo. Its drivers' folders are protected too.

close.description: How the close merges this repo. commit false: the script does not commit the branch of that repo, a person did. Absent: it commits, as on every branch of a spec. Empty cmd: a person merges it.

live.description: The real systems a test may write: github:org/repo, gitlab:group/project, cluster:laptop. The one-time yes; a test whose `touches` names anything else fails `spex check`.

people.description: Names that must not appear as an actor in a task or a test step: the person at the keyboard. A step that needs them is a manual step, and the process has none.

tests_scenarios.description: How many script tests one batch of /spex:implement writes at most; the skill takes batch after batch in one run.

step_introduces.description: How many names one step of a roadmap lists under Introduces before spex check warns that it is two steps.

verify_rounds.description: How many whole-feature verify rounds the loop may take before a person reads it.

auto.description: Auto mode: nobody is asked. The decider agent answers every question with evidence, and each digest lists its answers.

commit.description: The script commits on the base branch (the notes of new, new-bug and delete) only when this is true. With a merge command in close.cmd and a remote, it also pushes these commits: the request of a spec must not carry the notes. Without it, the reply names the files, and you commit and push them. On the branch of a spec the script always commits, at the end of each phase.

base.description: The branch a spec starts from and merges into. Empty: the branch the main folder is on.

close.description: How the close merges the branch of a spec. cmd: push, open the request and merge it (`gh pr create --fill && gh pr merge --squash`). Empty cmd: the run waits, a person merges, then types /spex:review again.

worktree.description: setup: what runs one time in a new worktree (install the packages, copy .env).

env.description: The environment the tests need, as scripts of this project. spex knows no tool. up: at the start of implement. deploy, check: before every full test run. down: at the close. url: where the tests find the app (SPEX_ENV_URL).
